}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== {{See also|Cisco|Meraki|Arcadyan}}
;Per the info on ''Cisco Meraki'''s product page.. *PBGA SoC chip package *The device has two Mini PCIe wireless module: :One 3x3 bgn module - [[Broadcom]] BCM43431KMLG :One 3x3 ac/an module - [[Broadcom]] BCM43460KMLG *There is an on-board (dual-band, single-stream) 'security radio' :(for [http://meraki.cisco.com/technologies/air-marshal-wips '''Air Marshall'''] functionality [rogue AP detection + mitigation, etc.]) : - may handle spectrum analysis functionality as well <small>(maybe)</small>
;Per the FCC photos... *The ''Air Marshall'' radio is a [[Broadcom]] BCM43428 :(BCM43428KMLG, HT1137 P20, 160994 6 W
;Per the datasheet.. *Beamforming is supported *For non-PoE power, barrel specs are 5mm OD, 2.1mm ID, center positive.. *Operation is possible w/ 802.3af PoE, with reduced functionality :(max. 13.87W 3af, max. 18W 3at) *The dimensions of the device are 253.4 mm x 155.8 mm x 37.1 mm, :not including the desk mount feet or mount plate. *The device weighs 25oz / 0.7 kg.
;Power adapters specified in the FCC test report are.. *''Powertron'' PA1015-2HU (100-240VAC ~ 50-60Hz, 0.4A -> 12VDC, 1.5A) *PoE: ''PowerDsine'' PD-9501G/AC (100-240VAC ~ 50-60Hz, 1.5A -> 55VDC, 1.35A)
